summary: Mendon's rulings on the Discipline/Absent PR: a Discipline play from a discard pile pays the Discipline cost first then the action's own cost as ONE combined GoldQuote (two payments, Gold does not carry over, offered only when both parts are payable), from hand only the action's own cost; wires Expensive Achievement, Knowledge and Power and Two Steady Breaths (strategy-wave-23; Mercantile Conflict stays blocked on an Honor-loss-increase primitive); pins Lost in Transit's two modes (no presence as an Open action, presence only as a Battle action; no behavior change needed); False Ring of Air's bow is a cost and it loses its free hand play. Shipped card art added under src/L5R.Client (three scans), no client code.
